answer.reason: The verses state two deeds of Ananias: ordering Paul struck and going down to accuse him before the governor.

clauses.english: commanded those standing by to strike Paul on the mouth
clauses.quote: commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth

clauses.english: went down with the elders and Tertullus to inform the governor against Paul
clauses.quote: Ananias the high priest descended with the elders
